result.summary: The layout is largely coherent, but there are several clipping and consistency defects: restaurant names in the horizontal carousel are hard-truncated at the viewport edge without ellipsis, the favorite (heart) buttons use two different styles, thumbnail treatments are inconsistent, and the last 'Popular right now' card is cut off behind the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card's title 'Trattoria Piccol...' and its delivery price are cut off abruptly at the right screen edge with no ellipsis or fade, making it look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis with a fixed card width, and add a right-edge peek/fade so the partially visible card clearly reads as horizontally scrollable content.

issues.description: The favorite heart buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card uses a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button on a single style (e.g., translucent dark scrim with white icon) across all cards, using state changes only for saved/unsaved.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is truncated mid-image by the bottom navigation bar, and the card has no visible title/metadata, so it appears clipped rather than intentionally cut.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset equal to the nav bar height to the scroll container so cards can scroll fully clear of the tab bar.

issues.description: Thumbnail treatments are inconsistent in the 'Fastest near you' row: the Green Bowl Poké image has a light gray background while the other two have dark photographic backgrounds, creating an uneven visual rhythm. The time badge on the light card also has weak contrast.
issues.suggestion: Normalize image backgrounds (or add a consistent gradient scrim) and ensure badges always sit on a scrim so text contrast is uniform.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off so that a chip after 'Healthy' is only a few pixels wide at the edge, which reads as a rendering glitch rather than a scrollable list.
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal padding/snap so a meaningful portion of the next chip is visible, or add an edge gradient to signal scrollability.

issues.description: Icon-only controls (notification bell with unread dot, favorite hearts) have no visible labels; if accessible names are also missing, screen reader users cannot identify them.
issues.suggestion: Provide aria-labels/content descriptions such as 'Notifications, 1 unread' and 'Add Tokumaru Ramen Bar to favorites', and ensure touch targets are at least 44x44pt.
